company.name: Majarra
company.shortDescription: Majarra is a leading Arabic digital content platform offering premium knowledge, technology, and educational.
company.description: Majarra is a UAE-based technology and digital media company focused on transforming Arabic online content by delivering reliable, high-quality knowledge platforms for Arabic-speaking audiences. The company operates a subscription-based network that gives users access to globally recognized content brands such as Harvard Business Review Arabia, MIT Technology Review Arabia, Stanford Social Innovation Review Arabia, Popular Science Arabia, Fortune Arabia, and other specialized platforms. Majarra combines technology, AI-driven personalization, and strategic publishing partnerships to provide content in areas including management, science, finance, psychology, innovation, and personal growth. Its mission is to bridge the Arabic digital knowledge gap and empower users with credible information that supports professional and personal development across the Arab world.
